Upon transfer, the courses listed below will:

• be awarded unit credit at a CSU;

• be applied to degree requirements based on CSU campus major and departmental articulation agreements and/or systemwide general education approvals.

Please note that while both lower and upper division community college courses may be listed, only lower division credit is awarded toward degree requirements.
